name: Default Theme
description: Apply an administrator-selected theme to newly created users or one existing user.

settings_schema.header: Set a theme for newly created users or apply one theme to one existing user.
settings_schema.footer: Paste the JSON exported from a Mattermost custom theme.

settings.help_text: Paste a valid Mattermost theme JSON object. Leave blank to use Mattermost's normal default theme.

sections.title: Set a theme for an existing user
sections.subtitle: Apply one custom theme to one human user or guest account.
sections.header: Enter both fields and save to apply the theme once. The fields clear after a successful save.
sections.footer: The operation does not enforce the theme. Invalid users, bots, incomplete requests, and invalid JSON are rejected.

settings.help_text: Select the existing human user or guest who should receive the theme.
Paste a valid Mattermost theme JSON object. Both target fields are required for a per-user assignment.
